solutions.title: Route BFS
solutions.strategy: Build stop-to-route membership, then BFS by route levels from every route serving the source stop.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every route-stop membership is processed at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stop map stores route membership for every listed stop.

solutions.title: Stop BFS
solutions.strategy: BFS over reachable stops while marking each route as boarded the first time it is expanded.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each route is expanded once and contributes its stops once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stop map, queues, and visited sets are linear in route-stop entries.
